name: @caotang/import-obsidian
description: The Obsidian vault and Longform reader for the Obsidian import (#281): wikilinks, embeds, comments, highlights, callouts, Dataview fields and the Longform index, read over the Markdown reader into the import block list with codex notes and attachments. No DOM and no third-party dependencies, so it runs on the main thread, in a 'self' Worker and in Node.
